page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top; below it a woodcut ornament, then a centred heading HOMILIA TRICESIMAPRIMA, then scripture reference lines and verse lines in the main column. Lower down, a large initial H opens the running text; a marginal note sits in the left margin beside the first lines of the text.

main_text.head: HOMILIA TRICESIMAPRIMA.
MATTH. 27.

p.i: A sexta autem hora tenebrae factae sunt super universam regionem usque ad horam nonam.

main_text.head: MARC. 15.

p.i: Quum vero aduenisset hora sexta, tenebrae factae sunt super totam regionem usque ad horam nonam.

main_text.head: LVC. 23.

p.i: Dixitque Iesu, Domine, memento mei quum veneris in regnum tuum.
Tum dixit ei Iesus, Amen dico tibi, hodie mecum eris in paradiso.
Erat autem quasi hora sexta, & tenebrae factae sunt super totam regionem usque ad horam nonam.

main_text.p: Oppositio mutua duorum istorum latronum antea tamen inter se si-Vivus historiae tam excellentis explicationem aggressi, dixi-mus in ea nobis mundi statum, ex peccatoribus compositi, re-praesentari: in medio quarum tenebrarum Iesus Christus adest ex ingenti sua

page.notes: The marginal note at left is set in italic and partly cut off at its line ends ("inter se si-" continues into the text). The large initial H is a woodcut initial. The ornament above the heading is a decorative woodcut. Some marginal and italic letters are blurred; readings of "Oppositio" and "mutua" are probable. The line "Dixitque Iesu" may read "Iesu," as printed.
